dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Fully is at risk due to behavioral reasons. Fully is reported to escalate to lunging, baring teeth, and growling. While in care, Fully was observed to bite the leash, growl at handlers, and thrash. In one instance, after exiting the kennel Fully jumped up towards the handler's hand. In kennel, Fully is receptive to a treat lure, which helps with leashing. Medically, Fully is apparently healthy.

Fully arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. It is reported that Fully will escalate to lunging, charging, baring teeth, and growling. While in care, Fully has been observed to leash bite, thrash while on leash, and growl at handlers. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experinced adult only home.
dog.name: Fully
